# REPRODUCE (generated by `paper/scripts/reproduce_md.py`; do not edit)

All computation runs through Slurm (`sbatch` + `srun`); the login node only runs git and file edits. Every script below is CPU-only
and reads locked experiment results; none writes into `experiments/`. Run from the repository root of branch `paper/composability`.

## Order

```bash
SCRIPT=scripts/build_claims.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=scripts/predictions_table.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=scripts/table1.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_fig1.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_fig2.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_fig3.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_fig4.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_fig5.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_fig6.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_figC1.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_figS1.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=figs/make_figS2.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=scripts/reproduce_md.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
SCRIPT=check.py sbatch --parsable --export=ALL paper/job_cpu.slurm
```

Then compile in a CPU job: `cd paper && tectonic --keep-logs main.tex` (tectonic 0.17.0 from conda-forge, installed with micromamba under /dataset1/zailong/envs/tectonic; it runs bibtex itself).
